title: The Dog Night, 2019
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty years. The outline. The box. The sign: seven dark. The strip is tired and doesn't hide it.

panels.composition: The outline. WOOD in it, hands in the flannel's pockets. BARNABY II sitting. The bin. The bulb, flickering.

image.prompt: a man and a three-legged dog inside a rust-stained rectangle on gravel behind a bowling alley at night, a blue bin, a flickering bulb, clean ink, no words
close-up of a wiry three-legged dog looking up, one ear up, no words

panels.composition: The porch. The box, sagging, twenty years of rain on it. The pup in it anyway.

image.prompt: a three-legged dog sitting in a badly sagging weathered produce box on a porch, a man on the step, night, no words

panels.composition: The sign. Seven dark. Wood not looking at it this year. Looking at the pup.

characters.pose: looking at the dog, not the sign

image.prompt: a man on a porch at night looking down at a dog in a box instead of at the distant bowling-alley sign with seven letters dark, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving
